name: Codex CLI (RHEL)
description: Installs the Codex CLI (OpenAI) from npm.

agentVersion.description: @openai/codex version to install. Leave empty to resolve the newest published npm version at install time and pin that exact version; it does not float on later rebuilds of the same layer.

pluginMarketplaces.description: Space-separated list of Codex plugin marketplaces (owner/repo, git URL, or local path) to add on container creation, e.g. 'anthropics/claude-plugins-official'. Setting this or plugins also installs git. Best-effort: a marketplace that cannot be added is logged and skipped rather than failing container creation. Leave empty to add none.

plugins.description: Space-separated list of Codex plugins to install on container creation, as plugin@marketplace, e.g. 'frontend-design@claude-plugins-official'. Each marketplace referenced here must also appear in pluginMarketplaces. Best-effort: a plugin that cannot be installed is logged and skipped rather than failing container creation. Leave empty to install none.
